questions.title: Which Ukrainian suspect, if any, will be arrested in August 2026 in connection with Germany's investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline bombings?

questions.title: Who will win the 2026 special election for California's 14th congressional district?
questions.background: A special election will fill the U.S. House vacancy created by Eric Swalwell's resignation in April 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Consistent winner projections reported by major U.S. news organizations based on special-election results. Resolution Event : Resolve when a winner is publicly projected for the special election to complete Swalwell's unexpired term. The November 2026 election for the following full term does not count. Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major escalation in spending and GOP voter outreach ahead of the Aug 18 CA-14 special runoff (ABC7 San Francisco Aug 11, Washington Examiner Aug 12, East Bay Insiders Aug 6-7, CBS News Aug 13): super PAC outside spending for Melissa Hernandez / against Aisha Wahab has more than doubled since Aug 6 to over $5M ($4.4M+ from AIPAC-affiliated groups alone, including a $1.2M single-day TV buy by United Democracy Project on Aug 6), while July 1-29 FEC filings show Hernandez raised $900,435 and spent $796,970 vs Wahab's $56,467 raised and $137,453 spent—and Wahab has largely refrained from matching TV buys. Combined spending now exceeds ~$6.5M to ~$0.7M (~9:1 overall, >20:1 on TV) in a low-turnout August special election, and For Our Values PAC is mailing GOP voters with Republican primary candidate Dena Maldonado's endorsement targeting the 40.4% non-Wahab/non-Hernandez June 16 primary pool. Still, Wahab remains roughly a 2-to-1 favorite given her 26-point June 16 special primary margin (42.8%-16.8%), State Senate base, CA Democratic Party and SEIU/labor ground game, lack of public polling showing Hernandez ahead, only 15 of Hernandez's 525 July donors residing in CA-14, and recent 2026 AIPAC/BOLD America defeats in MI-Sen and NY-13. Lowering Aisha Wahab 0.72 -> 0.64 and raising Melissa Hernandez 0.28 -> 0.36.

local_articles.title: Woman accused of plotting to kill Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is sentenced to 6 years in prison
local_articles.snippet: WASHINGTON: A Massachusetts woman who told police that she brought homemade firebombs to the US Capitol to kill Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was sentenced on Tuesday to just over six years in prison. Riley English, a 26-year-old transgender woman, said she was in the grips of a mental health crisis and abusing drugs when she drove to Washington in January 2025 and told Capitol police that she was there to kill Bessent on the day of his Senate confirmation. “I never wanted to hurt anyone,” she told US District Judge Rudolph Contreras. “I’m not a political person. I’m not a violent person.” Contreras, who was nominated to the bench by Democratic President Barack Obama, sentenced English to six years and one month of imprisonment followed by three years of supervised release.
